response.sql:
SELECT SUM(state_total) AS total_invoice_amount, AVG(invoice_count) AS average_invoices_per_state
FROM (
  SELECT c.State, SUM(i.Total) AS state_total, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
  FROM Invoice AS i
  JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
  WHERE i.InvoiceDate > '2010-06-22 00:00:00'
    AND i.InvoiceDate < '2012-06-26 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY c.State
) AS state_totals;

assumptions.assumption: A NULL State is grouped as one state group; the average is across state groups represented among customers with matching invoices. InvoiceDate comparisons use the database's datetime comparison semantics for these string literals.
